issue.title: Clean up old branches
issue.body:
Currently the repository contains a lot of old branches.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5948271/8020909/9a942064-0c8b-11e5-88c2-179eb7f40ce2.png)

Is there a specific reason why they are not deleted? For example branch issue230 has been merged into master back in 2012, but the branch is still alive.

Deleting old branches would make it easier to see ongoing contributions from pull-requests by both contributors and external users.
